turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so you have twenty minutes. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first; who decided that?
Then get to it. Did you speak to Owen before that mark went in, or after?
If you escalate this, I'll make sure the academic integrity committee sees everything, including his two late assignments from September.
Go ahead, I'm going upstairs next anyway. A teacher threatening to dig up two late assignments if a parent complains: I'm writing that down. Now, on what basis is there a zero?
My call. Then my call is the principal's office at 4:40, unless you show me something other than a threat.
